blocks.text: VALENCIA CITY, Bukidnon — Police arrested seven wanted individuals, including four listed as most wanted persons, in separate operations across Bukidnon and Manila from Nov. 20 to 24, 2026. In Manila, operatives from the Valencia City Police Station, Bukidnon Provincial Police Office, Regional Intelligence Unit 10, and Baseco Police Station nabbed Bukidnon’s eighth most wanted person at the provincial level on Nov. 23 at 11:00 a.m. The 36-year-old construction worker from Barangay Sinayawan, Valencia City was arrested at Baseco Compound, Port Area, Manila for four counts of rape with no bail recommended.
